01 · External factual-review copy

Pre-Existing Business & Expertise: Supporting Evidence

Factual chronology of business activities, experience and workflows predating the ELVT agreement.

Prepared by
Otto Rothfusz
Purpose
Supporting documentation provided for factual review
Evidence cut-off
Materials collected through 16 September 2026

This copy is intended for Keir Hübner / Keir Hubner Consulting L.L.C-FZ and, where applicable, an authorised legal representative. It is shared voluntarily to clarify the factual timeline. Providing access does not constitute an admission, waiver, or agreement with any legal interpretation.

Documented scope: before ELVT training and before contract signature, Otto Rothfusz had multi-platform social-media experience, short-form and long-form experience, creator and entrepreneur work, commercial social-media positioning, and an independently used content research and ideation workflow. This pack documents those pre-existing activities; it does not claim that every present-day service or workflow was identical at that time.

ContentsExecutive summaryChronologyExhibits E1 to E9Hiring calls E10 and E11Summary of the documented timeline

Executive summary

The strongest evidentiary sequence is chronological rather than dependent on any single screenshot. It starts with public and client-facing social-media work before ELVT, moves through direct positioning to entrepreneurs, then culminates in ELVT’s own hiring calls where Otto describes years of short-form and multi-platform experience and demonstrates a substantial personal-brand content workflow before ELVT training.

PointEvidence implication
Pre-existing fieldShort-form, long-form, Instagram, TikTok and social-media growth and content creation existed before ELVT.
Pre-existing commercial activityScreenshots show work around creators, entrepreneurs, highlights and stories, academy marketing and short-form distribution before ELVT.
ELVT knowledge before contractOn 24 November 2025, Otto told Keir, Ruben and Max he had five years of content experience, multiple platforms, 20k to 40k account growth and short-form and long-form experience.
Independent workflow before trainingOn 25 November 2025, Otto presented Brand DNA, target-audience research, outlier research, scripts, lifestyle concepts, transcripts and an AI and tone-of-voice process.
ELVT responseKeir said he liked the structure and that the process was great; Max said the workflow was great and that he also transcribed competitor videos, while explaining how ELVT did certain parts differently.
Scope noteThe pack documents prior capability, experience and business activity. It does not claim that the exact current InfoScale offer and ICP were already identical before ELVT.

These materials are provided to document the factual chronology of Otto Rothfusz’s business activities, experience and workflows before the ELVT agreement was signed, together with what was disclosed during the ELVT hiring process. The materials are not presented as a legal conclusion and do not replace the original source files.

“The Contractor agrees not to interfere with ELVT’s business by approaching or working with ELVT’s current clients, or by using ELVT’s systems or confidential information. Outside of this, the Contractor’s own business activities remain fully permitted and unrestricted under this Agreement.”

E1024 November 2025

ELVT Manager Meeting: pre-existing experience disclosed to ELVT

Key transcript excerpts

“I am creating content for five years… I did every platform you could imagine, from Snapchat, Spotlight, to Pinterest… most platform at least, getting around 20, 30, 40,000 followers… I have experience in short form and also in long form with YouTube.”

Otto · approx. 00:37 to 01:30

“I want to see how you’ve grown these accounts. What is your philosophy? What do you think of the Instagram algorithm? What works? What doesn’t work?”

Maksymilian · approx. 11:23

“Actually, I’m doing the same. So I look just at what works and I go all in on that. That is how I scaled at every platform.”

Otto · approx. 11:52

Context shown by this materialThis records what ELVT heard before contract signature: Otto described multi-platform account growth, short-form experience and long-form and YouTube experience during the hiring process.

E1125 November 2025

ELVT Content Check: independent personal-brand workflow before ELVT training

Otto’s own workflow before training

“I’ve actually watched [the onboarding] entirely through… I’ve analyzed all of them… I’ve called it here, the brand DNA… what I did is, I always use this strategy where I create a brand new account… scrolled for hours related to sales content… three high-end short-form scripts… looked at engagement… transcribed those scripts… train AI… understanding of his tone of voice.”

Otto · approx. 01:31 to 05:30

ELVT’s response

“I like the structure that you use. I think we need to train you in a few different ways…”

Keir · approx. 07:38

“what you’ve shown so far is really good… The process that you used is great.”

Keir · approx. 10:16

“I think it’s a great start… especially the fact that you didn’t use the onboarding transcript and the type form…”

Maksymilian · approx. 14:31

“your workflow is great… the fact that you transcribed competitor videos, I also do that… I do it in a different way…”

Maksymilian · approx. 18:02

“you got the job.”

Ruben · approx. 27:10

Context shown by this materialThis sequence shows Otto presenting a research and content workflow before ELVT-specific training, followed by ELVT explaining which parts it would train or approach differently. The original recording and transcript remain the primary source.

Summary of the documented timeline

Taken together, the materials document multi-platform content experience, short-form experience, entrepreneur-facing social-media work, creator and academy activity and a research and ideation workflow before the ELVT agreement was signed. During the hiring process, Otto presented Brand DNA, target-audience research, competitor analysis, scripts, lifestyle concepts and AI and tone-of-voice work before ELVT-specific training. The materials also show that ELVT later provided training and process refinements.

Source index: Fathom “Otto, Manager Meeting”, 24 November 2025 · Fathom “Otto, Content Check”, 25 November 2025 · Signed ELVT contractor agreement, Articles 9, 13 and 14 · Screenshots listed as Exhibits E1 to E9.
